sentences.en: The explorer pushed his way through the trackless mountain region.
sentences.zh: 这个勘探者硬生生地穿过了那片无路的山区。

sentences.en: Explorers have just discovered an unspoiled rainforest in Southeast Asia.
sentences.zh: 探险家们刚刚在东南亚发现了一片未被破坏的雨林。

sentences.en: Who cares what the site looks like on Internet Explorer.
sentences.zh: 管它在网上用的是什么浏览器呢。

senses.zh: 探险家；勘探者；探测器；[医]探针
